effects.lua_implementation: Standard Xyz procedure with archetype filter, Level 4, exactly two.

effects.printed_clause: If Xyz Summoned: add an "Arckcestial" Spell/Trap from Deck or GY; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed summon trigger checks Xyz type and searches Deck/Necrovalley GY under id HOPT.

effects.printed_clause: When a card/effect targets an on-field "Arckcestial" while this is in GY: Tribute an "Arckcestial"; Special Summon this card; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: GY EVENT_CHAINING inspects CHAININFO_TARGET_CARDS for an on-field archetype card, releases an archetype monster while preserving a zone, then revives this card; separate HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Chain target inspection plus Tribute-cost response structure.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from an "Arckcestial" Xyz to activate it: target an "Arckcestial" Spell/Trap in GY, add it, then discard; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed move trigger validates detach provenance, targets a Necrovalley-legal archetype Spell/Trap, then adds/confirms and discards under separate HOPT.

coverage_override.reason: The Xyz material requirement, Xyz-Summon search, targeted-Arckcestial GY revival response, and detached-material recovery/then-discard trigger are four units; every activated HOPT is included.
